items.title: AgenticRAGTracer: A Hop-Aware Benchmark for Diagnosing Multi-Step Retrieval Reasoning in Agentic RAG
items.title_zh: AgenticRAGTracer：诊断 Agentic RAG 多步检索推理的跳感知基准
items.summary: AgenticRAGTracer is an automatically constructed Agentic RAG benchmark of 1,305 data points that supplies intermediate hop-level questions so failures can be traced step by step. Even the best models do poorly, with GPT-5 reaching only 22.6% EM on the hardest portion, and hop-aware diagnosis attributes failures to reasoning chains that collapse early or over-extend.

items.title: ILION: Deterministic Pre-Execution Safety Gates for Agentic AI Systems
items.title_zh: ILION：面向智能体 AI 系统的确定性执行前安全门
items.summary: ILION is a deterministic pre-execution gate that classifies proposed agent actions as BLOCK or ALLOW through a five-component cascade, requiring no statistical training or labeled data and producing interpretable verdicts at sub-millisecond latency. On the 380-scenario ILION-Bench v2 it reports F1 0.8515 at a mean latency of 143 microseconds, outperforming Lakera Guard, the OpenAI Moderation API and Llama Guard 3.

items.title: Active perception and disentangled representations allow continual, episodic zero and few-shot learning
items.title_zh: 主动感知与解耦表征支撑持续的片段式零样本和少样本学习
items.summary: The authors describe a Complementary Learning System in which a fast learner gives up generalization in exchange for continual zero-shot and few-shot learning and operates as a parallel reasoning system rather than only as a replay buffer. A slow statistical learner, biased by context from the fast learner through active perception, encodes novel stimuli in familiar generalized terms.

items.title: Adaptive Data Augmentation with Multi-armed Bandit: Sample-Efficient Embedding Calibration for Implicit Pattern Recognition
items.title_zh: 多臂老虎机自适应数据增强：面向隐式模式识别的样本高效嵌入校准
items.summary: The authors propose ADAMAB, an embedding calibration framework for few-shot pattern recognition that trains lightweight, embedder-agnostic calibrators on frozen models and adds multi-armed-bandit-based adaptive data augmentation. It reports up to 40% accuracy improvement with fewer than five initial samples per class.

items.title: Retrieval Augmented Enhanced Dual Co-Attention Framework for Target Aware Multimodal Bengali Hateful Meme Detection
items.title_zh: 检索增强的双重协同注意力框架：面向目标感知的多模态孟加拉语仇恨模因检测
items.summary: The authors extend the Bengali Hateful Memes dataset with semantically aligned MIMOSA samples and propose xDORA, which fuses CLIP and DINOv2 vision encoders with XGLM and XLM-R text encoders through weighted attention pooling. RAG-Fused DORA adds retrieval-driven context and raises macro-F1 to 0.79 for hateful meme identification and 0.74 for target entity detection, while LLaVA remains weak in few-shot settings.

items.title: A Dataset for Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction from Art-historical Image Descriptions
items.title_zh: 艺术史图像描述的命名实体识别与关系抽取数据集
items.summary: FRAME is a manually annotated dataset of art-historical image descriptions collected from museum catalogs, auction listings, open-access platforms and scholarly databases, with stand-off annotations in metadata, content and co-reference layers. Its 37 entity types are aligned with Wikidata to support entity linking and downstream knowledge-graph construction, and it is released as UIMA XMI CAS files for benchmarking NER and relation extraction.

items.title: Scaling Inference-Time Computation via Opponent Simulation: Enabling Online Strategic Adaptation in Repeated Negotiation
items.title_zh: 通过对手模拟扩展推理时计算：在重复谈判中实现在线策略适应
items.summary: The authors scale inference-time computation for repeated strategic interactions by embedding smooth Fictitious Play into LLM inference, using an auxiliary opponent model that learns the opponent's time-averaged behavior in context and best-of-N sampling that simulates against it. Across two repeated negotiation games the method improves online performance without any parameter updates.

items.title: MentalBlackboard: Evaluating Spatial Visualization via Mathematical Transformations
items.title_zh: MentalBlackboard：用数学变换评估空间可视化能力
items.summary: MentalBlackboard is an open-ended benchmark for paper-folding and hole-punching tests that probes spatial visualization in vision-language models through prediction and planning tasks. Models struggled with symmetric transformations and rotations; Claude Opus 4.1 scored 10% on planning, while o3 reached 71.6% on a generalization task but only 25% on text-based prediction.

items.title: nextlevelbuilder/goclaw
items.title_zh: nextlevelbuilder/goclaw：用 Go 重写的 OpenClaw
items.summary: GoClaw is a Go rewrite of OpenClaw with multi-tenant isolation, a five-layer security model and native concurrency, aimed at deploying AI agent teams at scale.

items.title: Show HN: Local-First Linux MicroVMs for macOS
items.title_zh: Show HN：面向 macOS 的本地优先 Linux 微虚拟机
items.summary: Shuru is a lightweight sandbox that starts Linux VMs on macOS using Apple's Virtualization.framework, booting in about a second on Apple Silicon. Sandboxes are ephemeral by default, can be checkpointed, and have no network access unless explicitly allowed; it ships as a single Rust binary built for sandboxing AI agent code execution.

items.title: We hid backdoors in ~40MB binaries and asked AI + Ghidra to find them
items.title_zh: 我们在约 40MB 的二进制文件里植入后门，让 AI 与 Ghidra 去找
items.summary: Quesma introduces BinaryAudit, a benchmark that tests AI agents using Ghidra to find backdoors planted in compiled binaries of real open-source servers, proxies and network infrastructure.
